text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "experience" that Eishin Flash needs. 
It is not stacking up more mock races, but 
feeling firsthand the running of a Derby 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Coming to that conclusion, the Trainer 
asked Triple Crown Umamusume Mr. C.B. to 
run a tandem gallop, thanks to an 
introduction by Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. readily accepted, effortlessly 
defeating Eishin Flash and giving her a 
firsthand taste of "what it takes to win 
the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was the will to "win"—though skeptical 
of intuitive advice, Eishin Flash had 
grasped something vital.
